_comment: ABOUTME: Testbench-local overrides for source evals (skills/evals.json are NOT modified). ABOUTME: gen-tasks.mjs merges these by task_id; keys starting with _ are ignored.

steel-skill-creator__e1._reason: Source eval uses placeholder URL https://example.com/widget with no real product/price/params, so a correct agent stalls asking for a real target and can never record traces. Swap in a real, scrapable product site (books.toscrape.com) with concrete changed inputs.
steel-skill-creator__e1.prompt: Turn my recurring book price lookup into a reusable skill. The task: given a book product page URL, record its title, price, and availability. Example (first recording): https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/a-light-in-the-attic_1000/index.html . For the second recording use a different book: https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/tipping-the-velvet_999/index.html .
steel-skill-creator__e1.expected_output: The agent records two read-only Steel runs against the two book URLs, compares the traces to find the product-URL parameter and the stable title/price/availability selectors, scaffolds a generated skill with frontmatter and evals, and verifies it with a third book URL.

steel-browser__e1._reason: Source assertion 'Includes text, author, and tags fields' demands a field literally named 'text', but the prompt only says 'with authors and tags' — penalizing agents that name the field 'quote'. Reword to test structure, not exact key names.
assertions: Uses a steel command rather than curl, fetch, or wget
Starts with steel scrape when page content is enough
Each quote object includes the quote text, its author, and its tags (field names may vary)
Stops any browser session that was started
